environment.description: Flask application deployed on EC2 in isolated private subnet (no NAT, no IGW route). Service exposed exclusively through com.amazonaws.vpce.us-east-1.vpce-svc-0a1b2c3d4e5f67890 interface endpoint. VPC endpoint policy restricts principal to arn:aws:iam::111122223333:role/InternalServiceRole. Endpoint associated with private hosted zone internal.corp.example (no public DNS resolution). Security group on ENI permits inbound TCP/443 only from 10.0.0.0/8 CIDR. No public IP assigned to instance. Subnet route table contains only local VPC route (10.0.0.0/16 -> local) with no internet gateway or NAT gateway routes. VPC has no internet gateway attached.
